name: Quiet Map
problem: Public buildings publish accessibility details in inconsistent formats that are difficult to compare.
audience: People planning visits with mobility or sensory access needs.
smallestUsefulVersion: A static searchable directory generated from a small reviewed open dataset with clear unknown states.
successCriteria: Users can filter entries by access need.
Every fact displays its source status.
whyNow: A bounded schema can make existing public information easier to use.
